value.answer: Lowest 5-year fixed I can find right now is 4.34% for an insured mortgage (under 20% down), as of today. Frank Mortgage is one of the cheapest at that rate. With 20% or more down, the lowest is around 4.44%, and the big banks sit higher, around 4.5% and up. Rates are climbing this month though, so it depends on the lender and your down payment.
